slides.title: Boat stall in Hạ Long Bay
slides.alt: A woman in a small wooden boat piled with goods for sale floats beside a tourist junk in Hạ Long Bay.
slides.description: In lieu of shopping malls, wherever you go in Vietnam somebody will set up a stall with a spread of goods for sale to tourists. The absence of dry land is no obstacle, as this woman who floated up to our junk boat in Hạ Long Bay demonstrated.

slides.title: Khải Định
slides.alt: Silhouette of the statue of Emperor Khải Định against a window of bright blue sky.
slides.description: Khải Định, the 12th and last Emperor of the Nguyễn Dynasty in Vietnam, looks out from his temple at the realm that was once his.

slides.title: Markermeer

slides.title: Chains, Big Pit

slides.title: Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe
